name: Aniya Johnson
why: A posed Herald portrait of her alone holding the SGA banner, sharp and full-face; nothing better exists.
caption_quote: Aniya Johnson poses for a portrait outside the WKU Student Government Association chambers

name: Preston Romanov
why: Sole figure at the chamber podium in an SGA polo, sharp and full-face; the only Herald frame naming him.
caption_quote: Director of Public Relations Preston Romanov tells the SGA senators about their official Instagram account

name: Olivia Feck
why: Cropped from the senate bench; the caption names only Feck and she is the one figure in focus and mid-speech, everyone else in profile or blurred.
caption_quote: Senior Senator Olivia Feck speaks during ... Student Government Association's second session

name: Alex Cissell
why: Caption places Cissell at left of a two-person frame, so the left figure is her; the only Herald photograph naming her.
caption_quote: WKU senior public relations student Alex Cissell (left) and SGA Senator at Large Sophia Bryant (right)

name: Abbey Norvell
why: The crowned figure is the only person the caption names; the four SGA town-hall frames name three people without positions and identify nobody. Identity rests on the Herald and the archive both carrying one Abbey Norvell at WKU across 2019-2022, not on a caption stating her SGA office.
caption_quote: 2021 WKU homecoming queen Abbey Norvell celebrates with teammates after being crowed homecoming queen

name: Ashlynn Evans
why: Sole figure at the senate podium, sharp and full-face; the only Herald frame showing her clearly.
caption_quote: Ashlynn Evans, Director of Public Relations for SGA, speaks at the stand in the WKU Student Senate Chambers

name: Charlie Harris
why: A commissioned Herald portrait of him alone on the lawn, sharp and full-face; nothing better exists.
caption_quote: Morganfield senior Charlie Harris is a political science major

name: Corey Newsome
why: A posed Herald portrait of him alone on a stairway, sharp and full-face, made for his election as senator.
caption_quote: Corey Newsome, a freshman majoring in business economics, has been elected as a senator

name: Eric Smiley
why: Studio panel from a positioned four-up: the caption puts Smiley top left in a Sigma Chi shirt and the top-left panel wears the Sigma Chi letters, so the grid genuinely lines up. Frame is Feb 2011, between his two listed terms.
caption_quote: They include (top left) Danville junior Eric Smiley, Sigma Chi fraternity

name: Katie Stillwell
why: Studio panel from the same four-up; the other three panels carry exactly the Greek letters the caption assigns to their corners, so bottom left is Stillwell.
caption_quote: (bottom left) Bowling Green junior Katie Stillwell, Omega Pi Alpha sorority

name: Kaylee Egerer
why: The caption names only Egerer and she is the one figure in focus and mid-celebration, everyone else blurred or turned away.
caption_quote: Kaylee Egerer, Campus Improvements Chair, celebrates after Resolution 2-11-S ... was approved

name: Keyana Boka
why: A Herald frame of her alone captioned with her office; the celebration frames from 2013 are all tied to her election disqualification hearing.

name: Lily Nellans
why: A commissioned Herald portrait of her alone, sharp, well lit and full-face; the best frame of anyone in this sweep.
caption_quote: Lily Nellans, a junior from Des Moines, Iowa, ran for Student Government Association president

name: Nolan Miles
why: He is the only person standing and speaking in the frame, which is what the caption describes; face is in profile but sharp.
caption_quote: Executive Vice President Nolan Miles addresses attendees at the Student Government Association meeting

name: Kate Hart
why: She is the one figure holding the door and looking to camera, exactly what the caption describes; face is sharp and full.
caption_quote: WKU's SGA Senator and Academic Affairs Chair Kate Hart holds the door for fellow members of the SGA cabinet

name: Wade Pierce
why: Two men outside the Lambda Chi Alpha house; the caption puts Hinderbrandt on the left, so the right-hand figure is Pierce, and he is the senior of the two.
caption_quote: Hinderbrandt's Lambda Chi Alpha brother, Louisville senior Wade Pierce currently holds the position as Vice President

name: Paige Settles
why: Caption puts Settles on the left, so the maroon-clad figure is her. The one SGA frame naming her, from six months later, shows her at the podium far too small to crop; that figure is consistent with this one. The Herald calls her a senior here and a junior in March, which I take as its own error, not two students.
caption_quote: WKU senior and forensics team member Paige Settles, left, presents Bryan Sonnier ... the Top Novice award
